overview: Security configuration baseline for Microsoft Windows 10 Enterprise 22H2 workstations, aligned with hardening best practices.
purpose: Gather host configuration evidence via WinRM/PowerShell—including secedit, auditpol, built-in accounts, and HKLM/HKU registry settings—and evaluate Windows 10 Enterprise 22H2 systems against the defined security baseline to identify misconfigurations and compliance gaps.
